summary: Grant LaFontaine explains how selling Pokémon cards inspired a billion-dollar business
content:
World Service , · 25 Nov 2026 , · 17 mins

Grant LaFontaine is the co-founder and CEO of Whatnot, the live shopping platform where independent sellers generated more than $8 billion in sales last year. He explains how selling Pokémon cards as a child led to him co-founding the largest independent livestream shopping platform in North America, the UK and Europe, and why he backed livestream shopping long before most investors saw its potential. Presenter: Leanna Byrne Producer: Barbara George You can email the team: businessdaily@bbc.co.uk (Picture: Grant LaFontaine, CEO of Whatnot)
chineseSummary: 格兰特·拉方丹 (Grant LaFontaine) 解释了销售神奇宝贝卡如何激发了数十亿美元的业务
chineseContent:
全球服务 , · 2026 年 11 月 25 日 , · 17 分钟

Grant LaFontaine 是 Whatnot 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，Whatnot 是一个直播购物平台，去年独立卖家的销售额超过 80 亿美元。他解释了小时候销售神奇宝贝卡如何让他与人共同创立了北美、英国和欧洲最大的独立直播购物平台，以及为什么他早在大多数投资者看到直播购物的潜力之前就支持直播购物。演讲者：Leanna Byrne 制片人：Barbara George 您可以向团队发送电子邮件：businessdaily@bbc.co.uk（图片：Whatnot 首席执行官 Grant LaFontaine）
